reviews.t: Second- the texture is perfect! It`s not too light

I will use the shampoo again but not the conditioner. The conditioner may do better on different texture hair.

claims.text: Many reviewers report their hair became thicker, healthier, or grew faster after using the product.
The scent is frequently praised as pleasant, though some reviewers dislike it or find it too strong.
Several reviewers say the product leaves hair soft and moisturized, but others with curly or coarse hair found it drying, brittle, or lacking slip.
A few reviewers report negative results, including hair falling out or drying out on first use.
Some reviewers note the product works well for thick, curly, or coarse hair, while others with 3c/curly hair were disappointed.
